_comment: Pinned historical baseline for scripts/benchmark_vector_index_size.sh. It is retained for semantic index storage and throughput delta reporting only; pass/fail gates live in the script for retained semantic-index performance evidence. Regenerate with `just bench-vector-index-size` when the corpus, schema, or machine class meaningfully changes.

gates_at_capture.notes: Historical storage baseline for delta reporting. The retained gate is current-run db_size_bytes <= 80 MiB, indexing_ms <= 90000, and schema_version == 13; this snapshot is not itself release readiness evidence.
